newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion suffer reversal, world markets fall.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion suffer reversal, world markets fall.

text.p: Indian gold and silver prices saw reverse trends in early trade on Friday after previous gains as importers and stockists pumped in fresh stocks against a falling world market, dealers said.
On Wednesday, gold gained by 15 rupees per 10 grammes while silver was up by 25 rupees per kg. There was no trading on Thursday, in view of a Hindu festival.

Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) fell by 134 rupees at 59,816 rupees. They were up by 100 on Wednesday. "Arrivals of imported metals are high particularly for silver and traders expect a further slide later in the day," one broker said.
